name: Building a Ship
description: A ship is a normal build turned into a Simulated Contraption by the Physics Assembler.

pages.title: Building a Ship
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Glue a group with Super Glue or Honey Glue, then hold right-click on the **Physics Assembler** and pull its lever.
- Only glued groups move together. The built ship stays fully usable.
- Bearings used with Steering Wheels or Torsion Springs must be told not to disassemble.

A ship is a normal build turned into a [#](7A3C9A)[Simulated Contraption](entry://glossary/sub_level)[#]() by the Physics Assembler. [#](7A3C9A)[Glue](entry://glossary/super_glue)[#]() decides which blocks belong, so **only glued groups move together**.
Physics Assembler. More Simulated parts are in [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().

pages.title: Assembling
pages.text:
Select a group with Super Glue or Honey Glue, then **hold right-click** on the assembler and **pull the lever**.

- Blocks along diagonal edges are included.
- Once built, any Physics Assembler can [#](7A3C9A)[disassemble](entry://glossary/assemble)[#]() the ship.
- The ship stays fully usable: walk on it, open chests, run machines.

pages.title: Honey Glue
pages.text: Click two corners and ctrl-scroll to resize. It only joins ships and also takes overlapping Super Glue. Super Glue does not take Honey Glue.

pages.title: Weight and splitting
pages.text: Blocks have different weights. Some are light, super heavy, slippery or fragile. Sections that lose their connection split off as separate ships, and a Slime Ball merges any two.

pages.title: Swivel Bearing
pages.text: Turns the glued group in front of it into a rotating sub-ship. [#](2E5AAC)[Rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]() passes through the shaft. Redstone unlocks it to spin freely.

pages.title: Steering a propeller
pages.text:
Before you assemble the ship, give the part the swivel should turn its own small glue box. It can sit inside the ship's glue. Without one, only the block on the swivel's face turns.\
\
Put the engine behind the bearing: rotation goes through it to the part. A Steering Wheel on a cogwheel next to the bearing turns it.

pages.title: Docking Connector
pages.text: Two connectors align and lock into a rigid link. Items and fluids can then pass both ways. Retract either to undock.

pages.title: Passing items across
pages.text: Once docked, move items through the connectors with Create chutes or funnels: one feeding into the connector on one ship, one taking out of the connector on the other. Vanilla hoppers don't pass items through them.

pages.title: Rope Winch
pages.text: Link ships with a Rope Coupling between a winch and a connector. Rotation reels the rope in and out. Shears cut it.

pages.title: A rule that trips people up
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** [#](7A3C9A)[bearings](entry://glossary/bearing)[#]() must be told not to disassemble when used with Steering Wheels or Torsion Springs.\
\
Springs let a bearing swing within an angle and return when the input stops.
